titre: EEGAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Short- and Long-Horizon EEG Analysis
resume: arXiv:2609.31632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis is evolving from short-segment classification toward long-horizon interpretation that demands iterative evidence accumulation, multi-step reasoning, and coordinated use of specialized signal-processing tools.
